palette.notes: 19 colours measured, 2 ramps (median hue shift 7.5 deg, length 9.5). Each scene has its own mood palette: dusk maroon, day blue with peach clouds, teal night with orange lamps.

lighting: Strong single mood per scene: sunset glow, warm sodium lamps reflected on wet road, a tree glowing in the dark, a lit station on a blue night.
silhouette: Wide scenery; poles, trees and buildings in dark flat shapes against the sky; a tiny snowman is the only figure.

motion.timing: Mostly still: 1.7 drawings/s, 34 changes in 20 s; holds at 33.3 ms come from small looping bits (lights, stars, clouds). Each scene holds about 3 s before a cut.

texture: Native 96x170 at 6x scale, clean pixels, almost no dither; cloud and mountain shading done with flat bands.
camera: Locked frames, one cinemagraph per scene, hard cuts between scenes.

acting.acts: No acting characters; a slideshow of cozy places (fast food sign, clouds, town, wet road, Christmas tree, gas station).
acting.depth: Deep staging: tiny figures and props small against huge sky; reflections give depth on the road and the station.

techniques: cinemagraph: one or two looping lights per still scene
wet-road and water reflections of warm lights
tiny props small in a big sky for scale
feel: huge quiet sky + tiny lit props + one looping light per scene = cozy lo-fi calm
for_fred: Use a still scene where only one thing loops and put Fred small in the far background doing his gag; then cut close. Small-in-the-back, then big-in-front, is exactly the depth Robert wants.
